🦆 New navigation skills for a small robot.

Help Microduck find its way around obstacles with NVIDIA Isaac Lab and Newton. Follow the tutorial to train an obstacle-avoidance controller in simulation while keeping its walking policy fixed, then test it on hardware.

Read the tutorial on Hugging Face : 👉 https://nvda.ws/3VFYFUW
